source.provenance: Programme descriptions and guiding values transcribed from the supplied public edition of the GABS organisation profile.
source.publication_note: The public edition explicitly excludes detailed numerical impact tables.

disclosure_note: Detailed numerical programme measures are not displayed. GABS should provide explicit written approval and an authorised, dated public dataset before any numerical impact figures are published.

programmes.title: HIV/AIDS Care
programmes.summary: Education, prevention awareness, counselling, referrals, home-based care, patient support and support groups. Anon may complement this work with stigma-free educational information and signposting to verified services; it does not provide testing, treatment or clinical care.

programmes.title: Child and Youth Upliftment
programmes.summary: Moral education, life-skills development, remedial and academic support, psychosocial care, mentoring, education access and youth empowerment. Any Anon content for children and young people requires age-appropriate design and GABS safeguarding approval.

programmes.title: Wellness Education
programmes.summary: Health and hygiene education, mental wellness and self-care, nutrition and lifestyle awareness, community outreach, prevention and physical fitness. Anon may support this programme through accessible wellbeing education, not diagnosis or treatment.
